amendments.finding: The frozen row incorrectly says median day-six onset. The pinned Guide correctly says duration was six days; the raw primary Results state median onset three days (0 to 9) and median duration six days (1 to 55).
amendments.acceptedRequirement: Retain tocilizumab in 17 CRS participants, 11 also receiving steroids, and eight CRS participants without anti-cytokine treatment, with at least 12 weeks of observation and median CRS duration six days (range 1 to 55). Onset, if added, is three days (range 0 to 9).
amendments.evidence: PMC10427427 BioC paragraph 27 and pinned safety lesson table C.
amendments.denominatorEffect: No row, phase, source or section count changed; exact frozen bytes preserved. A later proof must expressly apply this correction rather than claim the onset wording was supported.

amendments.finding: The frozen uniqueLaterLessons key counts source pages: ten lesson chapters plus the guide index, at each pin. It does not mean eleven numbered teaching lessons.
amendments.acceptedTerminology: 11 source pages per pin: ten chapters and one guide index.
amendments.denominatorEffect: No source, section or requirement count changes; original frozen bytes remain preserved.

identityNormalizationNotes.finding: The title embeds entity-escaped sup tags. Crossref and Europe PMC identify the same title after two HTML-decoding/stripping passes; this is markup drift, not a different paper.

Europe PMC resolves the source to Frank 2020. Crossref returns Resource not found for the DOI and doi.org is unavailable through the web tool. Registry-access qualification retained; full-text support remains separately assessed.

scope: Ten later chapters plus one guide index read end to end before owner inspection.
